functional_checks.check: English H, English TH, and Latin-sound TH regression vectors
GUI workflow: dashboard, examples, alphabet filtering, history restore, clipboard, and CSV export
independent GitHub Windows builds and executable qualification

code_signing.disclosure: The v0.1.1 executables are not Authenticode-signed. Windows may display an Unknown Publisher or reputation warning; users must verify the published SHA-256 checksum before running them.

ordinary_user_acceptance.approval_basis: The repository owner iteratively reviewed the launched packaged application, requested usability corrections, and explicitly directed public release after the final workflow revision.
ordinary_user_acceptance.limitation: Human acceptance occurred on the Windows build workstation rather than a separate clean machine; clean Windows packaging and executable checks were independently repeated by GitHub-hosted runners.
